cases.sentence: Я не дам вредителям пожирать ваш урожай, и с ___ на ваших полях не опадут плоды, — говорит Господь Сил.
cases.explain: «виноградных лоз» — after the preposition «с», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast its fruit before its time in the field,” says Yahweh of Armies.

cases.sentence: Вы произносили ___ против Меня, — говорит Господь.
cases.explain: «жестокие слова» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “Your words have been stout against me,” says Yahweh. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’

cases.sentence: Что мы выгадали, исполняя Его уставы и ходя со ___ перед Господом сил?
cases.explain: «скорбными лицами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: You have said, ‘It is vain to serve God;’ and ‘What profit is it that we have followed his instructions, and that we have walked mournfully before Yahweh of Armies?

cases.sentence: — Они будут Моими, — говорит Господь Сил, — Моим ___ в тот день, когда Я буду действовать.
cases.explain: «драгоценным достоянием» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: They shall be mine,” says Yahweh of Armies, “my own possession in the day that I make, and I will spare them, as a man spares his own son who serves him.
